unverified_requirements.text: Reconstruct the cathedral as one architectural scale model. Preserve the twin tall front spires, nave and transepts, stepped roof volumes, repeated buttresses and pinnacles, large portals and window recesses, and the supporting base visible in the references. Use real geometry for the major tracery openings and repeated structural relief. Fine carved figures and microscopic masonry may be simplified. Interior rooms and walkable scene construction are outside this object reconstruction task.

unverified_requirements.text: Use real editable three-dimensional geometry. Preserve continuous curvature, thickness, recesses, openings, thin structures, connections and occlusions. Image planes or camera-facing shells are not substitutes for full geometry.
